# AgentZ vendored engine baseline

This source snapshot starts at piscis-engine commit `527e55496caf4437e4265e02869f0a8c764549f6` (tag `v0.8.68`). The initial integration applied AZ-029 and AZ-079. Subsequent changes include AZ-034 Windows AppContainer execution, AZ-081 excluded-directory traversal, AZ-082 LSP response resource scope, AZ-030 Windows DPAPI key protection, and AZ-083 AppContainer descendant test handshake. Their implementation and validation records are in `docs/upgrade/evidence/`.

Regenerate the candidate from the immutable commit with `node scripts/upgrade-kernel-candidate.mjs`, verify both patch hashes and tests, then review and update this directory as a product dependency change. The workspace package manifests declare their vendored engine workspace explicitly. AgentZ resolves the three packages with the path patches in the root `Cargo.toml`; `Cargo.lock` records the resolved graph.

The candidate script reconstructs only the patch sequence explicitly listed in that script (currently AZ-029, AZ-079, AZ-081, AZ-082, AZ-030). It does not include the AZ-034 AppContainer changes or all subsequent lint cleanups, and must not be described as byte-identical to this entire vendor directory. Validate both the relevant reconstructed candidate and the product dependency before acceptance. This note records provenance; it does not replace upstream copyright or license terms.

AZ-077 macOS Keychain and AZ-078 Linux Secret Service are subsequent platform adapter work, recorded separately in the ledger. The Linux dependency uses `vendor/secret-service` with explicit no-prompt policy; see its baseline note. These adapters are not included in the reconstructed candidate patch sequence above, and platform runtime acceptance remains separate from adapter typechecking.

2026-10-09: AZ-023 adds bounded retry classification; AZ-022 adds passive tool/process recovery observations and actual Windows pipe byte-count/cleanup confirmation. The DeepSeek Flash alias adaptation and opt-in synthetic live baseline are separate subsequent changes. The old candidate script now lists eight patches, still only a partial reconstruction. `scripts/upgrade-kernel-freeze.mjs` separately freezes the entire current product vendor against the immutable baseline and verifies complete forward/reverse/relocated byte equality. Its output is a reviewable source snapshot, not proof that every overlay has been independently accepted or that any release/install/platform Gate has passed. Current package version strings and upstream tag are distinct and must both be reported.
